verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a web scraping and crawling service, so blocking image and CSS resources to save bandwidth is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents resource-type blocking or a default bandwidth-saving mode. The items about URL blocking policies and per-key format restrictions are adjacent controls, not resource blocking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests
